parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of plastic, typically located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl for cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A flat, hinged cover made of plastic that closes over the toilet seat.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl to maintain hygiene and reduce odor when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge attached to the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A ring-shaped seat made of plastic that provides a comfortable sitting surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user while sitting and provides ergonomic comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or lowered along with the lid via a hinge mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic body of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank housing.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure anchored to the floor and plumbing system.
